Road accidents kill four Kanwar pilgrims in separate incidents

Two separate road accidents involving unidentified vehicles have resulted in the deaths of four Kanwar pilgrims. In Uttar Pradesh, on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway near Kalcheena village, an unknown vehicle collided with a motorcycle carrying three pilgrims who were en route to Haridwar from Jhajjar, killing all three. In Rajasthan, an out-of-control trailer hit Kanwar pilgrims, killing one and injuring another.
